description: The inputs of a colocation data-centre business case for one European market: construction cost per MW, colocation prices per kW-month, electricity price, staff cost, guarding, property tax, exit yield, grid wait, permitting and grid charges, with low and high. Needs a personal DC Blueprint key (Authorization: Bearer) from an account with a DC Blueprint licence or trial. Ask for one market for the project at hand: every figure costs 5 credits, one figure (the "figure" argument) 1; the same answer again in the calendar month costs nothing. It is not a way to copy the catalogue market by market. Markets: Amsterdam, Athens, Barcelona, Berlin, Copenhagen, Dublin, Frankfurt, Helsinki, Lisbon, London, Madrid, Milan, Oslo, Paris, Stockholm, Vienna, Warsaw, Zurich. Figures: Construction cost, Colocation price, retail, Colocation price, wholesale, Colocation price, large deals, Electricity price, Cost of a site employee, Guarding and monitoring, Property tax, Exit yield, Wait for a grid connection, Permitting, Grid connection charge, Customer substation.

figure.description: Optional: one figure only, e.g. "Construction cost" or "Exit yield" (1 credit). Leave it out for every figure of the market.

title: Data-centre business-case figures for one market
